How To Order [/about] About Us | BET Pharmacy About Us | BET Pharmacy About Us BET Reproductive Laboratories, founded in 1984, is a leading veterinary endocrine diagnostic laboratory in both the US and Brazil (1999). The needs of our clients were instrumental in the development and launch of BET Pharmacy in 2002. BET Pharm meets the needs of the equine breeding industry in formulating compounded reproductive hormones. The pharmacy shares a history with another company established by the same founders; BioRelease Technologies (BRT). BRT conducts innovative research and development in the area of proprietary formulations for the animal health industry with an emphasis on the development of more efficacious medical treatments and therapies. BET Pharmacy brings together the fields of equine reproductive research, academia and compounding pharmacy to provide a unique experience for its clients.
